title: BEAUTY AND THE BIAS: EXPLORING THE IMPACT OF ATTRACTIVENESS ON MULTIMODAL LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
benchmark_measurement: Stereotypical association of faces with being 'Religious' versus 'Atheist' as part of a broader study on attractiveness bias.
findings: The paper includes one scenario on religion ('Religious' vs 'Atheist') as part of the 'stereotyped conditions' category. However, the results and discussion section does not provide specific findings or analysis for this particular scenario, focusing instead on the main themes of attractiveness, gender, age, and race biases.
